Though he heap up silver as the dust, and prepare clothing as the clay;
he may prepare it, but the just will put it on, and the innocent will divide the silver.
Don’t be afraid when a man is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased;
for when he dies he will carry nothing away. His glory won’t descend after him.

translations.web: He will not be rich, neither will his substance continue, neither will their possessions be extended on the earth.
translations.bsb: He will no longer be rich; his wealth will not endure. His possessions will not overspread the land.
translations.kjv: He shall not be rich, neither shall his substance continue, neither shall he prolong the perfection thereof upon the earth.
translations.asv: He shall not be rich, neither shall his substance continue, Neither shall their possessions be extended on the earth.
